name.en: Center Laboratories (Sheng De Biotech Holdings / Center Ventures)
name.local: 晟德大藥廠股份有限公司

strategy.thesis: Originally a liquid-dosage pharma manufacturer, Center Laboratories acquired its captive VC arm (玉晟生技創投) in 2008 and fully converted into a professional biotech investment holding company in 2022, deploying capital across API/niche generics, biologics (antibodies, proteins, vaccines), CNS drugs, ADCs and cell therapy — styling itself Taiwan's 'biotech Berkshire Hathaway'.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Runs a portfolio of ~20 core/non-core bio subsidiaries, several already IPO'd on Taiwan's TWSE/TPEx (順藥, 益安, 博晟, 東曜, 永昕, 加科思, 建誼, 豐華).

notable_investments.company: 浩鼎/加科思 (Genor/InventisBio, listed as 加科思)

sources.title: 晟德大藥廠股份有限公司
sources.supports: founding year, VC arm acquisition, portfolio scale/returns, notable investees
sources.quote: 2008年併購「玉晟生技創投」，正式轉型為「生技工業銀行」。2022年4月進一步整併玉晟生技，轉型為專業生技投資控股公司。

sources.title: 晟德集團攜手子公司，打造台灣生技波克夏！聚焦CDMO、AI、高階醫材，立足台灣放眼世界
sources.supports: strategic framing as biotech investment holding company

verification_notes: Well-documented via GlobalBio (environmentally authoritative Taiwan biotech trade press) with a direct fetch confirming figures; portfolio count '~20' is an approximation reported in secondary coverage, not an official single verbatim figure.

summary.en: Legacy Taiwanese liquid-dosage pharma manufacturer that converted into a professional biotech investment holding company ("Taiwan's biotech Berkshire Hathaway"), deploying capital into ~20 portfolio companies spanning APIs, biologics, CNS drugs, ADCs and cell therapy.
summary.local: 晟德大藥廠由傳統內服液劑藥廠轉型為專業生技投資控股公司，被稱為「生醫界的波克夏」，旗下轉投資約20家公司，涵蓋原料藥、生物製劑、神經科用藥、ADC與細胞治療。

name.local: 鑽石生技投資股份有限公司

strategy.thesis: Founded in 2013 by biotech drugmaker 中天生技 (Champion Biotechnologies) together with corporate LPs Fubon Financial, Taishin Financial and Ruentex Group as Taiwan's first publicly-listed sustainable biotech-focused venture investment vehicle; has since incubated/backed 20+ biotech startups.

sources.title: 鑽石投資出清合一持股 中天生技及兩家國際投資機構吃下
sources.supports: founding year, founding shareholders, portfolio scale/valuation
sources.quote: 鑽石生技投資是台灣第一家上市的永續型生技創投，創始股東包含中天生技、富邦金控、台新金控及潤泰集團。鑽石專注生技醫療投資領域，已於海內外投資及育成20多家優秀生技新創公司。

sources.title: 鑽石投資出清合一持股 中天生技及兩家國際投資機構下
sources.supports: existence, official press release confirming exit from Oneness Biotech stake

verification_notes: Diamond Bio Fund's own 'about us' page returned a 404 at time of research; facts sourced from its own press-release page (still on diamondbiofund.com) and a reputable secondary brokerage-news write-up. Portfolio count and 'unicorn' framing are as reported in secondary coverage, not independently verified against a primary portfolio list.

summary.en: Taiwan's first publicly-listed sustainable biotech venture-investment vehicle, spun up in 2013 by pharma company Champion Biotechnologies (中天生技) alongside financial-conglomerate LPs; has invested in/incubated 20+ biotech startups including Oneness Biotech and GlycoNex.
summary.local: 由中天生技集團於2013年發起成立的台灣第一家上市永續型生技創投，聯合富邦金控、台新金控、潤泰集團出資，已投資育成20多家生技新創，包括合一生技、醣基生醫等。

strategy.thesis: Qisda (BenQ Group), an electronics manufacturer whose healthcare business has grown to roughly 13% of consolidated revenue, runs a dedicated medical/'smart healthcare fleet' business unit that makes strategic equity investments in Taiwanese medtech/diagnostics startups to build an integrated care-continuum platform (hospitals, devices, AI diagnostics, pharmacies).

sources.supports: healthcare business revenue scale (NT$26.3B, 13% of group revenue)

sources.title: 佳世達醫療大艦隊 領軍出擊2026 Medical Taiwan

The AM BioTech investment detail was captured via aggregated search-result synthesis rather than a directly fetched verbatim article; treat the specific claim as medium-confidence.

summary.en: Electronics manufacturer Qisda (BenQ Group) has built healthcare into ~13% of group revenue via hospitals, medical devices and AI diagnostics, and makes strategic equity investments into Taiwanese medtech/diagnostics startups such as exosome-diagnostics firm AM BioTech.
summary.local: 佳世達（明基集團）醫療事業占集團營收約13%，透過旗下醫院、醫材與AI診斷佈局，並對台灣醫材/診斷新創（如外泌體診斷公司陞醫生技）進行策略投資。

name.local: 緯創醫學科技股份有限公司

strategy.thesis: Wholly-owned medical arm of Wistron Corporation (a Fortune Global 500 ODM), combining Wistron's manufacturing/AI capability with medical-device OEM/ODM, exoskeleton robotics and AI contactless-care systems; the wider Wistron Group has committed roughly NT$2B to a smart-healthcare investment vehicle backing a dozen-plus startups in the space.

sources.title: 緯創醫學科技-智慧醫療與醫材代工引領者
sources.supports: existence, parent company, focus areas (medical devices, robotics, AI care systems)
sources.quote: 緯創醫學科技結合緯創集團的科技實力與醫療專業

sources.title: 台商回台搶新創 電子五哥投資拚轉型
sources.supports: NT$2B smart-healthcare investment vehicle backing a dozen-plus startups

verification_notes: Wistron's official medtech site describes itself primarily as a medical-device OEM/ODM and does not itself disclose CVC/portfolio details; the NT$2B investment-vehicle / dozen-plus-startups figure comes from secondary trade press and may refer to a related but distinctly-named Wistron biotech holding vehicle rather than Wistron Medtech itself — flagged as a naming ambiguity.

summary.en: Wholly-owned medical-device arm of Taiwanese ODM giant Wistron, combining OEM/ODM manufacturing with AI care systems and exoskeleton robotics; the wider Wistron Group has invested roughly NT$2B in over a dozen smart-healthcare startups.
summary.local: 緯創集團旗下的醫材代工暨智慧醫療子公司，結合OEM/ODM製造與AI照護、外骨骼機器人開發；緯創集團另投入約新台幣20億元佈局逾十家智慧醫療新創。

name.en: Advantech Strategic Investment (Smart Healthcare / StarFab IoT Accelerator)

name.local: 保瑞藥業股份有限公司

strategy.thesis: Bora runs a 'dual-engine' model combining branded/specialty pharma sales with a CDMO platform built substantially through strategic investments and acquisitions of biologics manufacturing assets — e.g. its 2025 strategic investment/merger with Tanvex BioPharma to form Taiwan's largest international biologics CDMO team, and its 2026 agreement to acquire MacroGenics' spun-off CDMO business for US$122.5M.

sources.title: 保瑞泰福合併案始末，台灣艦隊攻全球生物製劑 CDMO 舞台
sources.supports: strategic merger/investment in Tanvex BioPharma to build biologics CDMO platform

sources.title: 保瑞砸1.225億美元收購美國CDMO廠 擴大生物藥版圖

sources.supports: US$122.5M acquisition of MacroGenics' spun-off CDMO business
sources.quote: 保瑞宣布董事會核准以1.225億美元收購MacroGenics分拆的CDMO業務

summary.en: Taiwan-headquartered specialty pharma and CDMO company that has grown its biologics manufacturing platform primarily through strategic investment and M&A, including a 2025 merger with Tanvex BioPharma and a 2026 US$122.5M acquisition of MacroGenics' CDMO business.
summary.local: 總部位於台灣的專科藥品暨CDMO公司，主要透過策略投資與併購擴大生物製劑產能平台，包括2025年與泰福生技合併、2026年以1.225億美元收購MacroGenics的CDMO業務。

name.local: 台耀化學股份有限公司

sources.quote: 程正禹持續轉投資包括：台康、台新藥、台睿等，跨足大分子製藥、新藥開發、CDMO
